user.title: Connect your Unraid worker
user.description: Pair with your local DwellMind Docker service. The pairing key stays private. HTTPS is recommended; HTTP requires explicit consent on a trusted local network.

data.allow_http: Allow unencrypted HTTP on my trusted local network

rooms.title: Choose your rooms
rooms.description: Select Home Assistant Areas. Devices inherit room membership; explicit entity assignments take precedence. Nothing is removed or reassigned.

entities.title: Review observations
entities.description: Select up to 40 entities to observe. Unavailable devices remain unknown. Motion, occupancy and derived helpers are evidence, not verified human presence. Configuration and diagnostic entities are excluded. Discovery uses current HA assignments; future changes require another review. Capture starts only when you press its button.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the worker. Check its URL, protocol and capture status.
error.no_entities: No supported entities found. Check HA Area assignments and device classes.
error.invalid_selection: Select 1–40 discovered entities and a valid capture duration.

init.title: Choose your rooms
init.description: Stop the current capture before changing its selection.

entities.title: Review observations
entities.description: Review discovered entities. Excluding a device does not delete its HA entity or captured history.

error.cannot_connect: Worker refused the configuration. Stop an active capture and check connectivity.
error.no_entities: No supported entities found in these areas.
error.invalid_selection: Select 1–40 discovered entities and a valid capture duration.
